matchedListeningFixtures.name: matched-mild
matchedListeningFixtures.sourceDefinition: 0.2*sin(2*pi*440*t)+0.08*sin(2*pi*3700*t), t=n/48000; second channel polarity inverse; common scale applied to both saved files
matchedListeningFixtures.matchingMethod: Trim from independent reference RMS; check rendered RMS; common peak scale for source and wet if needed. These saved signals are comparison material, not listening observations.
